column1: # Desktop / GUI: niri (scrollable-tiling Wayland compositor) + Noctalia v5 shell.
# NB: Noctalia v5 does NOT use Quickshell or Qt. It is a single native binary
# linked against cairo/pango/harfbuzz/glib. Do not add `quickshell` here.

column5: notes
ships its own niri.service, niri.desktop and niri-portals.conf
niri auto-spawns it and sets DISPLAY when present
bar, launcher, notifications, lock, calculator (links libqalculate)
launches apps as app-niri-<id>@<hex>.service so the Firefox MemoryHigh cap works
serves org.freedesktop.appearance + ScreenCast
FileChooser; niri-portals.conf prefers gnome then gtk
Secret Service; replaces kwallet, which goes with Plasma
without an agent, every GUI password prompt silently does nothing
Noctalia's GTK template syncs adw-gtk3/adw-gtk3-dark
only OBS and Telegram are left on Qt after the KDE apps go
AUR-only, and every terminal/editor config in this repo names it
Noctalia UI font
the repo package, not the Flatpak: VA-API against system ffmpeg
the terminal; Konsole is gone
GUI file manager (Dolphin replacement)
right-click extract, using the file-roller backend
thumbnails for Thunar
Ark replacement; p7zip/unrar in core.tsv are the backends
Okular replacement. NB: no annotation or form filling - swap to `papers` if you need either
Gwenview replacement
the -bin: building vesktop from source is a 30-60min Electron build on 4C/8T
Wayland has no clipboard owner after an app exits
niri has built-in screenshot binds; grim/slurp are for scripted captures
VA-API for UHD 620; LIBVA_DRIVER_NAME=iHD is set in environment.d
provides `vainfo`
